_comment: The graph POST /openai/v1/images/edits renders. Same job as
text-to-image.json, with one difference that is the whole point: the
sampler starts from the caller's own image encoded into a latent
(LoadImage -> VAEEncode) instead of an empty one, and ${denoise} decides
how much of it survives. 1.0 would discard the input entirely, which is
No ${width}/${height}: the input image's own dimensions are the output's.
Scaling it here would silently resize what a caller handed over, and a
caller who wants a different size can send a different image.
${image} is a filename inside comfy's own input directory, which the door
put there by POSTing the upload to /upload/image first -- a container
reads only what was handed to it, so a path from the caller would name
nothing. Same substitution rules as the other graph: every ${name} is
replaced before submission, keeping its own type, and an unfilled one is
